screen.criterion: Per-thread CPU deltas; previous or current CPU in 16-31/48-63 counts as target overlap. Reject >=0.8 target CPU or >=2 external CPUs globally. Monitor pinned to CPU0; guarded descendants excluded.
screen.caveat: Periodic /proc sampling cannot prove exclusive ownership or attribute every migrating/short-lived thread; all samples retained. P31 affinity-only results are not reclassified.

interpretation.reason: All six cached-variant medians exceed same-batch tuned SLEPc; zero-cluster regresses against P29. The broader real-complex and large-certificate gaps remain unresolved.
interpretation.qualification_policy: A case comparison is usable only if all solvers and all five repetitions pass validation and per-run monitoring; no individual repetitions dropped.
interpretation.primary_source_note: LAPACK GBTRF/GBTRS layout and pivot ordering checked against official Netlib documentation; SIMD loop implementation is independent.
interpretation.null_count_limit: Counts small D eigenvalues over completed factorization; exact-zero early abort does not recover full null multiplicity.
